gov10.pager.label: Pages
gov10.red.title: Procurement red flags
gov10.red.subtitle: OCP indicators computed from the bid and contract data, ranked so that the auditors know which package to look at first.
gov10.red.notice: This is a signal for review, not a conclusion. Only auditors can see it; people who took part in the package or the contract do not see the signal about it.
gov10.red.back: Back to the list of signals
gov10.red.scanFailed: The scan failed. The scheduled scan still runs; try again later.
gov10.red.score.name: Signal score
gov10.red.score.formula: The score is the sum of the weights of the indicators that fired; from the high line it is High, from the medium line it is Medium. It only orders the review and says nothing about wrongdoing.
gov10.red.score.source: The rule RED_FLAG_RANKING and the weight of each indicator in RED_FLAG_RULE
gov10.red.column.subject: Package or contract
gov10.red.stale: The list could not be refreshed; the last answer is shown.
gov10.red.empty.none: The last scan found no signals.
gov10.red.empty.never: No scan has finished yet, so it cannot be said that there are no signals. Scan again.
gov10.red.empty.denied: You do not have the right to see procurement red flags.
gov10.red.indicator.splitProcurement: Split procurement to avoid the threshold
gov10.red.indicator.nearThresholdDirectA: Several direct awards near the threshold
gov10.red.indicator.directAwardThenChang: Direct award, then a change over the threshold
gov10.red.indicator.awardVsFinalPriceGap: Gap between the award price and the contract value
gov10.red.indicator.awardAtOrAboveEstima: Award at or above the estimate
gov10.red.detail.title: Signal detail
gov10.red.detail.subtitle: Each indicator with its measure, threshold, formula and the history of the review.
gov10.red.detail.lowerBound: {count} indicators could not be computed for want of facts, so this score is a lower bound.
gov10.red.detail.needsSecond: You proposed it; a different auditor has to confirm it or send it back.
gov10.red.reasonHint: At least 5 characters; the reason goes into the audit trail.
gov10.red.error.selfApproval: The one who confirms must be a different person from the one who proposed.
gov10.red.error.conflict: The signal has just changed; reload and try again.
gov10.red.error.refused: This step could not be done.
gov10.red.registry.title: Registry of red-flag indicators
gov10.red.registry.subtitle: Each indicator has its formula, source, the day its numbers were taken, the threshold in force and its legal status.
gov10.ladder.title: Channel ladder and delivery receipts
gov10.ladder.subtitle: An urgent alert goes from the application to push, Zalo and SMS by receipt, not by what was sent; when the rungs run out it goes to the next level.
gov10.ladder.noFigures: A message of the ladder carries no financial figure: only the kind of alert, its level and a link that needs a login.
gov10.ladder.stale: Part of the page could not be refreshed; the last answer is shown.
gov10.ladder.denied: You do not have the right to see the channel ladder of the alerts.
gov10.ladder.policy.title: The ladder in force
gov10.ladder.policy.name: Ladder of the {severity} level
gov10.ladder.policy.handOff: to the next level after {minutes} minutes
gov10.ladder.policy.noHandOff: no hand-off to the next level
gov10.ladder.policy.stopSeen: Stops when the person has seen it.
gov10.ladder.policy.stopDelivered: Stops when the message has reached the device or the inbox.
gov10.ladder.kpi.title: Delivery of urgent alerts
gov10.ladder.kpi.source: The tables alert_ladder_run and alert_ladder_rung; receipts read back from the notification engine
gov10.ladder.kpi.failed: The delivery figures could not be read.
gov10.ladder.channels.title: How each channel ended
gov10.ladder.runs.title: Ladders that run and ran
gov10.ladder.runs.emptyFiltered: No ladder is in this state.
gov10.ladder.runs.failed: The list of ladders could not be read.
gov10.ladder.reason.profile: By the notification profile of the person
gov10.feedback.title: Reports that an alert is wrong
gov10.feedback.subtitle: The queue of the owners of the alert types: accept for tuning, reject with a reason, or mark as a duplicate.
gov10.feedback.notice: A report never hides or silences an alert. A change of the rule has to go through the governance rules with a maker and a different checker.
gov10.feedback.stale: The queue could not be refreshed; the last answer is shown.
gov10.feedback.empty.pending: No report is waiting for a review.
gov10.feedback.empty.filtered: No report is in this state.
gov10.feedback.reasonHint: Your words are kept with the report, never in the audit trail or an event.
gov10.feedback.error.self: The reviewer must be a different person from the reporter.
gov10.feedback.error.conflict: The report has just changed; reload and try again.
gov10.feedback.error.refused: This step could not be done.
gov10.feedback.error.noDuplicate: There is no other pending report of the same type to point at as the original.
gov10.feedback.stats.title: Share of reports by type
gov10.feedback.stats.formula: Reports of a type divided by the alerts of that type shown in the period; from {line} percent up, with at least {min} alerts, the type goes into review.
gov10.feedback.stats.failed: The shares could not be read.
gov10.feedback.report.title: Report a wrong alert
gov10.feedback.report.hint: At least 5 characters for another reason.
gov10.feedback.report.notHidden: The alert stays in your list; the owner of the alert type will review it.
gov10.feedback.report.already: You have already reported this alert and it is not reviewed yet.
gov10.feedback.report.gone: This alert is no longer in your list.
gov10.feedback.report.failed: The report could not be sent; try again.
gov10.closures.title: Closed and reopened alerts, and alert storms
gov10.closures.subtitle: The system closes an alert only when the condition of its source cleared and the source answered in every list.
gov10.closures.denied: You do not have the right to see the report of closings.
gov10.closures.formula: Counted from the events of opening, closing and reopening of each alert, not from a counter.
gov10.closures.filter.noRecord: Only alerts closed with no record
gov10.closures.feedbackLink: Reports that an alert is wrong
gov10.closures.empty.none: The system has not closed any alert yet.
gov10.closures.failed: The list of closed alerts could not be read.

gov10.flood.title: My list
gov10.flood.failed: The flood state of the list could not be read.
gov10.flood.active: A storm since {since}: {count} new alerts in {window} minutes. New alerts below the urgent level are gathered into cards.
gov10.flood.calm: No storm: {count} new alerts in {window} minutes.
gov10.flood.today: Today there are {count} new alerts; the cap for a day is {cap}.
gov10.flood.unavailable: These sources could not be read: {sources}. This list may be incomplete.
